text:
maria: Heads up — PO 327918 is stuck in AWS marketplace publishing. Procurement portal rejected: vendor_id mismatch. Anyone seen this mapping issue before? cc @kevin
procurement-bot: Procurement check: PO 327918 flagged: vendorId != registered_vendor_id. (rule: vendor_verify_v2)
kevin: On it. Which vendor alias is in the AWS manifest?
maria: AWS shows vendor alias: 'Redwood-Inference-LLC' but our finance system expects 'Redwood Inference, Inc.'
sam: :grimacing: Merchant registry canonical id vs alias trimming. Could be whitespace/punctuation normalized differently. I can run a quick mapping.
sam: Running quick diff... results: AWS vendor_checksum=7a3f, finance_vendor_checksum=7a3f-legacy (suffix).
sam: Looks like the marketplace published with a legacy suffix. We should add a mapping rule for the suffix. Proposal: allow normalized match by removing punctuation and suffix tokens.
elaine: Legal flagged an issue with automatic mapping — vendor name variance could break tax/matching. We need PO-level exception to bypass strict validation for this merchant.
kevin: Two options: (A) add mapping in vendor directory (low-risk, longer lead), (B) create temporary approval in procurement portal for PO 327918. Which does product prefer?
maria: Customer prefers faster enablement — they'd like the purchase to go through today. Can we do (B) and simultaneously kick off (A)?
kevin: I can create the one-off approval, but need a signoff from finance on invoice reconciliation. @ella_finance?
elaine: Finance (ella_finance) OOO til 5pm PT. I can approve on behalf for reconciliation note if procurement logs the exception. please include audit tag 'marketplace-vendor-mapping'.
kevin: Done — created exception, added audit tag. Pushed PO through. Patch ticket to vendor-mapping repo: https://git.internal/redwood/vendor-mapping/pulls/712
procurement-bot: PO 327918 status: published ✅. Exception logged: marketplace-vendor-mapping #712
maria: :tada: Thanks team. Can someone follow up to make mapping change permanent? Sam?
sam: I'll open the mapping PR today and add normalization tests. ETA EOD.
